title: StokenETF
tagline: A Web3-based exchange traded fund for securitized tokens using GHO as a stablecoin.
description: The SEC has approved 11 ETFs (Exchange Trade Funds) for Bitcoin. This project seeks to extend this idea to tokens on the Ethereum Blockchain. GHO will be used as a stablecoin where the value of the fund will be quoted in GHO. Other tokens will be created to represent real-world assets.
how_its_made: This project will use the GHO token as a stablecoin and use other tokens (created for this project) to securitize real world assets. This project will use React, smart contracts and the GHO system. At this point I'm not sure what else will be used. An Ethereum testnet will also be used.
